description.value: Four-fold, black and white photo-illustrated brochure for Mont Gabriel, a skiing lodge in Quebec, Canada. Recto: Features a man skiing mid-air at lower left, with trees covered in snow behind and above him. Printed in red, at top and center: Ski / at / Mont / Gabriel. Printed in white, against a red band, along the bottom: PIEDMONT near ST. SAUVEUR / PROVINCE QUEBEC • CANADA. Verso and interior feature red and black illustrated maps. Black and white photographic reproductions appear throughout the interior, along with printed black and red text.

legal.credit: Museum purchase with funding provided by the Buddy Taub Foundation, Dennis A. Roach and Jill Roach Directors

description.value: Advertisement proof for Gloria-Weberei featuring a sun at upper left and grey clouds and stars at upper right, with a blue sky behind both images. Printed in black, above sun: ob Tag; below sun: ob Sonne; above cloud: ob Nacht; below cloud: ob Regen. Blue and white rectangular images are below–a city scene at lower left and a landscape with a body of water at lower right. Printed in black, above city scene: ob Stadt; below: die Mäntel / Juwel, Jewelette, Juwelosa sind / stets schön, praktisch, elegant; above landscape: ob Land. Below the landscape, the logo for Gloria Weberei, a black and white triangle with the company name on the sides and a seal or sea otter inside, appears. Printed in black, underneath logo: Achten Sie auf dieses / Echtheitszeichen.
